title: Michael sees football-field-sized octagon craft for human relocation

tellings.quote:
human relocation as as Michael saw with
the large football field sized eight
gone craft

plain: A person who posts about UFOs online as UAPGerb tells of a witness named Michael who saw a huge eight-sided craft about the size of a football field. According to UAPGerb, such a craft would be used for moving humans from one place to another, which would mean someone is planning to relocate people on a large scale.
